title: Integrability of x ↦ ξ(x)(ω(x)) for a bounded a.e.-measurable multivector field and a test form
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n, i.e. continuous linear functionals on n-covectors) μ-a.e. strongly measurable and such that, for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every n-covector α (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm). Let ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (TestFormOn U n) with underlying form ω̂. Then x ↦ ξ(x)(ω̂(x)) is μ-integrable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → Integrable (fun x => ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) μ
